info.title: StreamAtlas prototype contracts
info.description: Node/SQLite source-of-truth endpoint contract subset. Literal route coverage is checked with strict inventory; regex/dynamic handler and media binary contract review remains incomplete. NOT a production publishing approval.

409.description: Incorrect offset, mismatched retry bytes, corrupted spool or concurrent upload

413.description: Excessive size or chunk crossing file boundary

parameters.name: X-Upload-Offset
parameters.description: Byte offset. Replays at an already committed offset are safe only if bytes match.

schema.description: Private, at most 2 MiB per chunk

put.description: The private single-writer SQLite upload spool is synced before progress is committed. A crash may leave extra spool bytes; only byte-identical replay can repair them. This does not provide distributed locking or S3 multipart resumability.

503.description: External integration not configured or unavailable

post.description: Development outbox only; returns 503 when no verified delivery provider is configured. No account enumeration.
Signed vendor callback: raw request body, authenticated by configured HMAC headers and secret, otherwise 503/401. Cookie login is not accepted as proof.

get.description: Opt-in, server-to-server Bearer token; unavailable without a >=32 character configured secret.
